disco_controls.name: A grid with a clock
disco_controls.description: Local console selects checker, rows, diagonals, snake or SUPER TRIANGLE on the existing disco floor; hold, single step and speed. SUPER TRIANGLE continuously turns and groups two-tone motifs from diagonals and chevrons into larger diamonds. Colour mode adds a separate palette control.
disco_controls.qfep_connection: A repeated rule makes an address, a field or an environment; the receiver and body determine what can be encountered.
